column5: Now… imagine every one of them, gone.
The power plants run on, with no one left to feed them.
One by one… the lights go out.
Beneath New York, seven hundred and fifty pumps have stopped.
With no one to paint it, the Eiffel Tower rusts…
Forests have taken back our cities.
But one thing we made will outlast us all…
Still here, thousands of years from now.
So tell me… would Earth even miss us?
